5/ **Episode 2: It Wasn’t a Rug Pull, It Was a Liquidity Crisis**

Sam insists FTX was *never insolvent* and that this was all just a misunderstanding. You know, like when your friend spends rent money on Dogecoin and swears he has a plan.
